glosses: A person who plays with or practices allegedly supernatural magic.
A spiritualist or practitioner of mystic arts.

examples.text: The truth is that [Isaac] Newton was very much a product of his time. The colossus of science was not the first king of reason, Keynes wrote after reading Newton’s unpublished manuscripts. Instead “he was the last of the magicians”.

glosses: A performer of tricks or an escapologist or an illusionist.
An amazingly talented craftsman or scientist.
A person who astounds; an enigma.

translations.source_sense_description: meist männliche Person mit magischen Fähigkeiten

glosses: Someone, usually male, who uses (or has skill with) magic, mystic items, and magical and mystical practices.

examples.text: The wizard conjured up a large fireball.
The wily wizard must be caught.

glosses: One who is especially skilled or unusually talented in a particular field.

examples.text: He was a financial wizard, capable of predicting the movements of the stock markets.

glosses: A computer program or script used to simplify complex operations, often for an inexperienced user.

examples.text: Use the "Add Network Connection" wizard to connect to a network in a series of simple steps.
